function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate entries, and `sample_seq` ranges from 1 to 2. This indicates that 48 patients were re-tested (i.e., appear in two rows). The data dictionary states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.", "implication": "We must deduplicate the dataset on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Failure to do so would double-count 48 patients, biasing any proportion estimate. This affects the population definition and must be done before computing response rates."}
function.name: note_finding
